topic: The bathroom mirror on a bad-hair morning.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: The Bathroom Mirror

shots.narration: I showed one honest reflection. Now apparently I'm the problem.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon bathroom, rounded mirror above a white sink, peach tiles, no writing.
shots.action: The mirror, with big expressive eyes and a small mouth on its glass, recoils from a towering tuft of messy hair reflected below its face.
shots.mood: Warm morning light, wide-eyed comic alarm.

shots.narration: My morning started peacefully. Then the hair arrived.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same cosy bathroom, rounded mirror and white sink, rear edge of a messy-haired head in the foreground.
shots.action: The mirror, with big expressive eyes and a small mouth, stares downward at the reflected nest of tangled hair.

shots.narration: [sarcastic] Yes, tilt your head. Perhaps gravity accepts requests.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same bathroom mirror, messy hair visible at the bottom of the reflection.
shots.action: A partially visible head tilts sideways beneath the mirror's unimpressed big eyes and small mouth.

shots.narration: One brushstroke. Somehow, we've added another direction.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same rounded mirror over the sink, plain hairbrush beside a reflected unruly tuft.
shots.action: A hand draws the brush upward through the hair beneath the mirror's worried big eyes and small mouth.

shots.narration: Now comes water. Mostly on me, naturally.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same bathroom, rounded mirror above a white basin.
shots.action: A splash of water spatters the mirror's glass around its big expressive eyes and small mouth.

shots.narration: [sighs] Steam finally gives us both a little privacy.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same warm bathroom, damp rounded mirror with messy hair faintly reflected.
shots.action: Condensation spreads across the mirror's glass, softly obscuring its big eyes and small mouth.

shots.narration: Apparently, hiding the evidence isn't part of my job.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same fogged bathroom mirror, plain hand towel held at the glass.
shots.action: A hand wipes one clear stripe through the fog, revealing the mirror's big eyes and small mouth.
shots.mood: Clean bright stripe against mist, reluctant anticipation.

shots.narration: There it is. Same hair, now with extra determination.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same mirror with a clear stripe, one stubborn hair tuft reflected beneath its face.
shots.action: The mirror, with big expressive eyes and a small mouth, gives the unchanged upright tuft a defeated sideways glance.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Tomorrow, ask the hairbrush. I'm being framed.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same bathroom, thick rounded mirror frame, plain hairbrush resting prominently on the sink.
shots.action: The mirror, with big expressive eyes and a small mouth, directs an accusing glance toward the hairbrush.
shots.mood: Cheeky courtroom-style suspicion, bright playful finish.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the hairbrush gives its side of the story.
episode.description: A bathroom mirror survives a bad-hair morning and somehow gets all the blame. There’s only so much an innocent reflection can do.
